nodes.title: Hazards are huge in randbats
nodes.description: Boots and removal are rare. Toxic Spikes wins games vs teams with few Poison types. Get setter in safely, never risk it. Don't set rocks while threat sets up. Don't sacrifice team for useless layers. If opponent has hazards and we don't, play faster.

nodes.title: Loss reviewer defaults to Grok 4.7
nodes.description: Do not default the post-game reviewer to anthropic/claude-opus-4.5. Prefer the newest xAI Grok frontier model on the gateway.
nodes.context: Queried GET https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models on 2026-10-04. Newest Grok language model is spacexai/grok-4.7 (released 2026-09-21). Newer language models exist (openai/gpt-6.1-sol 2026-09-29, anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 2026-09-22) and are recorded as alternatives. Claude Opus 4.5 is outdated and is not the default.
nodes.decision: Default LOSS_REVIEWER_MODEL is spacexai/grok-4.7. Input $0.000002/token ($2/1M), output $0.000006/token ($6/1M), cached input $0.0000005/token. Long context above 200001 tokens is input $0.000004 and output $0.000012. Override with the LOSS_REVIEWER_MODEL env var.
alternatives: anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 at input $0.000004/token ($4/1M) and output $0.00002/token ($20/1M), released 2026-09-22
openai/gpt-6.1-sol at input $0.000002/token ($2/1M) and output $0.00001/token ($10/1M), released 2026-09-29
nodes.consequences: Reviewer findings are hypotheses only and are not applied to code. Jev stays the in-search advisor at typesafe-ai/jev, input $0.000000042/token ($0.042/1M) and output $0.

nodes.title: Challenger: Jev search prior
nodes.description: Gate challenger only. Champion blend mode stays off. Degrades to pure search when the gateway key is missing or the call exceeds the turn latency budget.

nodes.kill_condition: Reject on any guardrail violation or if SPRT accepts H0 (no Elo gain).

nodes.title: Jev prior on top-K search actions
nodes.description: Off by default. A gate challenger may blend Jev scores into search. Missing key or timeout degrades to pure search. Not applied to the champion.

metadata.killCondition: Reject if any hard guardrail fails, including timeouts or p99 >= 2s, or if SPRT accepts no difference.

nodes.rationale: Random-battle search scores are often close. A fast evaluation model can score the same top-K actions and either nudge the ranking (prior) or break ties, without replacing search.
nodes.expected_effect: Challenger Elo vs the frozen panel rises by about +10 if the prior corrects systematic mistakes, with p99 turn time still under 2s.
nodes.test_plan: Submit experiment-llm-jev-prior against the champion through the gate. Challenger config is experiments/llm-jev-prior/config.json (blend mode prior, weight 0.15, topK 8). Champion stays useLLMPrior false. Paired games, SPRT elo0=0 elo1=+10 alpha=beta=0.05.

nodes.title: Exact 1-ply HP search
nodes.description: Clone the live battle with toJSON/fromJSON. Opponent line is the @smogon/calc max-damage move. Eval is HP fraction plus faint counts. Terminal win is +1000.
nodes.predicted_effect: >=90% vs random and >=70% vs max-damage over 300 paired games, 21/21 diagnostics, 0 invalid.
nodes.kill_condition: Under 90% vs random or under 70% vs max-damage, or any invalid choice, crash, or turn over 2s.

nodes.title: Rebuilt battles scored as losses
nodes.description: The 3-ply search is weak because it rebuilds a battle and scores a rejected choice as a loss, not because HP eval is too small.
nodes.rationale: After a KO the live request is a single switch. BattleStateBuilder starts a new battle, copies HP, and leaves a two-player move request. makeChoices throws Not all choices done. simulateTurn returns terminated with no winner. RobustSearch scores that -10000. A toJSON clone of the same battle accepts the switch.
nodes.expected_effect: 1-ply search on a real battle clone with HP-fraction eval beats random by a wide margin and beats max-damage. Adding depth, a uniform opponent, or the full evaluator does not create the old loss.
nodes.test_plan: Diagnostics on 21 obvious positions. Paired games, swapped sides, seed 1. Baseline exact:1,max-damage,hp over 150 pairs vs random and vs max-damage. Then uniform, depth 2, depth 3, and full eval on the same seeds. Kill the clone engine if it is under 90% vs random or under 70% vs max-damage.

nodes.title: Champion: exact 1-ply HP search
nodes.description: 1-ply exact @pkmn/sim battle clone. Opponent line is the accuracy-weighted max-damage move. Eight RNG draws are averaged. Eval is HP fraction plus faint counts.

nodes.title: Ablation of exact battle-clone search
nodes.description: Same seed start 1. Champion row is 150 pairs. Other rows are smaller samples of the same harness. Full eval before the 0 HP fix is the row that collapses.

nodes.title: 0 HP was scored as a full health bar
nodes.description: The full evaluator treated a falsy currentHp as unknown and assumed 100% HP.
nodes.rationale: Full-eval 1-ply lost to max-damage 2-38 over 40 games while HP-fraction eval won. Fainted Pokemon have currentHp 0.
nodes.expected_effect: Counting 0 HP as fainted restores full-eval win rate to the same range as the HP eval.
nodes.test_plan: Replay 20 paired seeds against random and against max-damage before and after the truthiness fix.

nodes.title: 0 HP is a faint
nodes.description: Do not use a truthiness check on current HP.
nodes.insight: A fainted Pokemon at 0 HP was scored as full health, so the full evaluator avoided knockouts.
nodes.evidence: Before: 5.0% vs max-damage (2W-38L/40) and 72.5% vs random (29W-11L/40). After: 77.5% (31W-9L/40) and 100% (40W-0L/40). Seed 1. Commit fcd9c92.

nodes.title: Search the live battle clone
nodes.description: A rebuilt battle that rejects the live choice is not a loss.
nodes.insight: The old search rebuilt a battle that still had a move request after a KO, rejected the legal switch, and scored that rejection as a loss.
nodes.evidence: src/engine/exact/legacy-repro.ts. The clone search is 98.0% vs random and 78.0% vs max-damage over 300 paired games, gate promoted, commit fcd9c92.
